name: schedule_create
description: Create a new schedule that runs a workflow on a cron expression. Use standard cron syntax (e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' for weekdays at 9 AM). The workflow will be executed with the provided input parameters on each scheduled run.

workflow_id.description: ID of the workflow to run when the schedule fires

workflow_input.description: Input parameters for the workflow (key-value pairs matching the workflow's parameter nodes). Call workflow_parameters first to discover required keys.

description.description: Optional human-readable description used to auto-generate a display name

cron_expression.description: Cron expression defining when the schedule runs (e.g. '0 9 * * *' for daily at 9 AM)

agent_id.description: ID or name of the agent that owns this schedule

session_id.description: ID of the parent session to attach this schedule to

name.description: Display name for the schedule (auto-generated from workflow ID if omitted)

color.description: Color identifier for the schedule card (e.g. 'blue', 'green', 'slate')

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the cron expression (e.g. 'America/New_York')
